name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.add_I_surjective_of_isSelfAdjoint
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.add_I_surjective_of_isSelfAdjoint (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    Function.Surjective (fun x : A.domain => A x + Complex.I • (x : E))

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.cayleyTransform_apply_plus
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.cayleyTransform_apply_plus
    (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (x : A.domain) :
    cayleyTransform A hA (A x + Complex.I • (x : E)) =
      A x - Complex.I • (x : E)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.norm_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.norm_cayleyTransform (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A)
    (y : E) : ‖cayleyTransform A hA y‖ = ‖y‖

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.sub_I_surjective_of_isSelfAdjoint
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.sub_I_surjective_of_isSelfAdjoint (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    Function.Surjective (fun x : A.domain => A x - Complex.I • (x : E))

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.cayleyTransform_unitary
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.cayleyTransform_unitary
    (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    cayleyTransform A hA ∈ unitary (E →L[ℂ] E)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.dense_range_one_sub_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.dense_range_one_sub_cayleyTransform
    (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    DenseRange (fun x => x - cayleyTransform A hA x)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.one_not_mem_eigenvalues_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.one_not_mem_eigenvalues_cayleyTransform
    (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    ∀ x, cayleyTransform A hA x = x → x = 0

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.inverseCayley_cayleyTransform
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.inverseCayley_cayleyTransform
    (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    inverseCayley (cayleyTransform A hA) (cayleyTransform_unitary A hA)
      (one_not_mem_eigenvalues_cayleyTransform A hA)
      (dense_range_one_sub_cayleyTransform A hA) = A

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.monotone
Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.proj_biUnion_finset
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.proj_biUnion_finset {I : Type*} (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (s : Finset I) (A : I → Set ℝ) (hmeas : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (A i))
    (hpair : (↑s : Set I).PairwiseDisjoint A) :
    E_pvm.proj (⋃ i ∈ (↑s : Set I), A i) = ∑ i ∈ s, E_pvm.proj (A i)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.proj_union
Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.integral_mul
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.integral_mul (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hbddf : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) (hbddg : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ C)
    (hbddfg : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖(f * g) t‖ ≤ C) :
    E_pvm.integral (f * g) (hf.mul hg) hbddfg =
      E_pvm.integral f hf hbddf * E_pvm.integral g hg hbddg

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.integral_sub
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.integral_sub (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hbddf : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) (hbddg : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ C)
    (hbddsub : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖(f - g) t‖ ≤ C) :
    E_pvm.integral (f - g) (hf.sub hg) hbddsub =
      E_pvm.integral f hf hbddf - E_pvm.integral g hg hbddg

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.norm_integral_le
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.norm_integral_le (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) {C : ℝ} (hbdd : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖E_pvm.integral f hf ⟨C, hbdd⟩‖ ≤ C

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.norm_simpleIntegral_le
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.norm_simpleIntegral_le (E_pvm : PVM E) (f : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) {C : ℝ}
    (hbdd : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) : ‖E_pvm.simpleIntegral f‖ ≤ C

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.norm_simpleIntegral_sub_le
Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.norm_sq_simpleIntegral
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.norm_sq_simpleIntegral (E_pvm : PVM E) (f : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) (x : E) :
    ‖E_pvm.simpleIntegral f x‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ z ∈ f.range, ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (@inner ℂ E _ (E_pvm.proj (f ⁻¹' {z}) x) x).re

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.proj_fiber_mul_proj_fiber
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.proj_fiber_mul_proj_fiber (E_pvm : PVM E) (f : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ)
    {z w : ℂ} (hzw : z ≠ w) :
    E_pvm.proj (f ⁻¹' {z}) * E_pvm.proj (f ⁻¹' {w}) = 0

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_add
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_add (E_pvm : PVM E) (f g : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (f + g) = E_pvm.simpleIntegral f + E_pvm.simpleIntegral g

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_const
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_const (E_pvm : PVM E) (z : ℂ) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (SimpleFunc.const ℝ z) = z • 1

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_map
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_map (E_pvm : PVM E) {β : Type*}
    (f : SimpleFunc ℝ β) (g : β → ℂ) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (f.map g) =
      ∑ y ∈ f.range, g y • E_pvm.proj (f ⁻¹' {y})

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_map_mul_map
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_map_mul_map (E_pvm : PVM E) {β : Type*}
    (f : SimpleFunc ℝ β) (a b : β → ℂ) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (f.map a) * E_pvm.simpleIntegral (f.map b) =
      E_pvm.simpleIntegral (f.map fun z => a z * b z)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_mul
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_mul (E_pvm : PVM E) (f g : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (f * g) = E_pvm.simpleIntegral f * E_pvm.simpleIntegral g

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_neg
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_neg (E_pvm : PVM E) (f : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (-f) = -E_pvm.simpleIntegral f

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_one (E_pvm : PVM E) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (1 : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) = 1

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_piecewise_const
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_piecewise_const (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (S : Set ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (z : ℂ) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral
        (SimpleFunc.piecewise S hS (SimpleFunc.const ℝ z) (SimpleFunc.const ℝ 0)) =
      z • E_pvm.proj S

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_sub
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_sub (E_pvm : PVM E) (f g : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (f - g) = E_pvm.simpleIntegral f - E_pvm.simpleIntegral g

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.simpleIntegral_zero (E_pvm : PVM E) :
    E_pvm.simpleIntegral (0 : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) = 0

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.star_simpleIntegral_mul
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.star_simpleIntegral_mul (E_pvm : PVM E) (f : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) :
    star (E_pvm.simpleIntegral f) * E_pvm.simpleIntegral f =
      ∑ z ∈ f.range, (star z * z) • E_pvm.proj (f ⁻¹' {z})

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.sum_proj_fiber_eq_one
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.sum_proj_fiber_eq_one (E_pvm : PVM E) (f : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) :
    (∑ z ∈ f.range, E_pvm.proj (f ⁻¹' {z})) = 1

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.sum_proj_preimage
Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.tendsto_simpleIntegral_of_tendstoUniformly
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.tendsto_simpleIntegral_of_tendstoUniformly (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (hbdd : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C)
    (s : ℕ → SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ)
    (hs : TendstoUniformly (fun n t => s n t) f Filter.atTop) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => E_pvm.simpleIntegral (s n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (E_pvm.integral f hf hbdd))

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.exists_bounded_simpleFunc_tendstoUniformly
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.exists_bounded_simpleFunc_tendstoUniformly (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (C : ℝ) (hbdd : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) :
    ∃ s : ℕ → SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ,
      TendstoUniformly (fun n t => s n t) f Filter.atTop ∧
        ∀ n t, ‖s n t‖ ≤ C

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.coordinate_unboundedIntegral_isFormalAdjoint
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.coordinate_unboundedIntegral_isFormalAdjoint (E_pvm : PVM E) :
    let A := E_pvm.unboundedIntegral ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable
    A.IsFormalAdjoint A

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.inner_coordinate_unboundedIntegral_self
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.inner_coordinate_unboundedIntegral_self (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (x : (E_pvm.unboundedIntegral ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable).domain) :
    @inner ℂ E _ (x : E)
        (E_pvm.unboundedIntegral ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable x) =
      ∫ t, (t : ℂ) ∂(E_pvm.scalarMeasure (x : E))

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.inner_integral_self
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.inner_integral_self (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (hbdd : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C)
    (x : E) :
    @inner ℂ E _ x (E_pvm.integral f hf hbdd x) =
      ∫ t, f t ∂(E_pvm.scalarMeasure x)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.inner_simpleIntegral_self
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.inner_simpleIntegral_self (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) (x : E) :
    @inner ℂ E _ x (E_pvm.simpleIntegral f x) =
      ∫ t, f t ∂(E_pvm.scalarMeasure x)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.integral_mem_domain_unboundedIntegral
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.integral_mem_domain_unboundedIntegral
    (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (hbdd : ∃ C, ∀ r, ‖f r‖ ≤ C)
    (g : ℝ → ℂ) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hprodBdd : ∃ C, ∀ r : ℝ, ‖g r * f r‖ ≤ C) (x : E) :
    E_pvm.integral f hf hbdd x ∈
      (E_pvm.unboundedIntegral g hg).domain

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.mem_domain_unboundedIntegral
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.mem_domain_unboundedIntegral (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (x : E) :
    x ∈ (E_pvm.unboundedIntegral f hf).domain ↔
      ∫⁻ t, ‖f t‖₊ ^ 2 ∂(E_pvm.scalarMeasure x) < ⊤

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.ofReal_norm_sq_integral
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.ofReal_norm_sq_integral (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (hbdd : ∃ C, ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) (x : E) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (‖E_pvm.integral f hf hbdd x‖ ^ 2) =
      ∫⁻ t, ‖f t‖₊ ^ 2 ∂(E_pvm.scalarMeasure x)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.ofReal_norm_sq_integral_sub_unboundedIntegral
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.ofReal_norm_sq_integral_sub_unboundedIntegral (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (hbdd : ∃ C, ∀ r, ‖f r‖ ≤ C)
    (g : ℝ → ℂ) (hg : Measurable g)
    (x : (E_pvm.unboundedIntegral g hg).domain) :
    ENNReal.ofReal
        (‖E_pvm.integral f hf hbdd (x : E) - E_pvm.unboundedIntegral g hg x‖ ^ 2) =
      ∫⁻ r, ‖f r - g r‖₊ ^ 2 ∂(E_pvm.scalarMeasure (x : E))

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.ofReal_norm_sq_simpleIntegral
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.ofReal_norm_sq_simpleIntegral (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : SimpleFunc ℝ ℂ) (x : E) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (‖E_pvm.simpleIntegral f x‖ ^ 2) =
      ∫⁻ t, ‖f t‖₊ ^ 2 ∂(E_pvm.scalarMeasure x)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_add_le
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_add_le (E_pvm : PVM E) (x y : E) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    E_pvm.scalarContent (x + y) S ≤
      2 * (E_pvm.scalarContent x S + E_pvm.scalarContent y S)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_countably_additive_tendsto
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_countably_additive_tendsto (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E)
    (S : ℕ → Set ℝ) (hmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (S i))
    (hpair : Pairwise (Disjoint on S)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, E_pvm.scalarContent x (S i))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (E_pvm.scalarContent x (⋃ i, S i)))

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_empty
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_empty (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) :
    E_pvm.scalarContent x ∅ = 0

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_eq_norm_sq
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_eq_norm_sq (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    E_pvm.scalarContent x S = ‖E_pvm.proj S x‖ ^ 2

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_nonneg
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_nonneg (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    0 ≤ E_pvm.scalarContent x S

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_proj
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_proj (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) (S T : Set ℝ)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hT : MeasurableSet T) :
    E_pvm.scalarContent (E_pvm.proj S x) T = E_pvm.scalarContent x (T ∩ S)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_smul
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_smul (E_pvm : PVM E) (c : ℂ) (x : E) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    E_pvm.scalarContent (c • x) S = ‖c‖ ^ 2 * E_pvm.scalarContent x S

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_union
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarContent_union (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) {S T : Set ℝ}
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hT : MeasurableSet T) (hdisj : Disjoint S T) :
    E_pvm.scalarContent x (S ∪ T) =
      E_pvm.scalarContent x S + E_pvm.scalarContent x T

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_apply (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    E_pvm.scalarMeasure x S = ENNReal.ofReal (E_pvm.scalarContent x S)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_integral
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_integral (E_pvm : PVM E)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (hbdd : ∃ C, ∀ r, ‖f r‖ ≤ C)
    (x : E) :
    E_pvm.scalarMeasure (E_pvm.integral f hf hbdd x) =
      (E_pvm.scalarMeasure x).withDensity
        (fun r => ((↑(‖f r‖₊ ^ 2) : ENNReal)))

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_lt_top
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_lt_top (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) (S : Set ℝ) :
    E_pvm.scalarMeasure x S < ⊤

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_proj
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_proj (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    E_pvm.scalarMeasure (E_pvm.proj S x) = (E_pvm.scalarMeasure x).restrict S

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_univ
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_univ (E_pvm : PVM E) (x : E) :
    E_pvm.scalarMeasure x Set.univ = ENNReal.ofReal (‖x‖ ^ 2)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.scalarMeasure_zero (E_pvm : PVM E) :
    E_pvm.scalarMeasure (0 : E) = 0

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.unboundedIntegral_eq_of_proj_eq_on_measurable
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.unboundedIntegral_eq_of_proj_eq_on_measurable
    (E₁ E₂ : PVM E)
    (hproj : ∀ S : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet S → E₁.proj S = E₂.proj S)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) :
    E₁.unboundedIntegral f hf = E₂.unboundedIntegral f hf

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.unboundedIntegral_integral
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.unboundedIntegral_integral
    (E_pvm : PVM E) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hfBdd : ∃ C, ∀ r, ‖f r‖ ≤ C)
    (g : ℝ → ℂ) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hprodBdd : ∃ C, ∀ r, ‖(g * f) r‖ ≤ C) (x : E) :
    E_pvm.unboundedIntegral g hg
        ⟨E_pvm.integral f hf hfBdd x,
          E_pvm.integral_mem_domain_unboundedIntegral
            f hf hfBdd g hg hprodBdd x⟩ =
      E_pvm.integral (g * f) (hg.mul hf) hprodBdd x

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.selfAdjoint_le_coordinate_unboundedIntegral_of_cayley
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.PVM.selfAdjoint_le_coordinate_unboundedIntegral_of_cayley
    (E_pvm : PVM E) (A : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A)
    (phase : ℝ → ℂ) (hphaseMeas : Measurable phase)
    (hphaseBdd : ∃ C, ∀ r, ‖phase r‖ ≤ C)
    (hphaseRelation : ∀ r : ℝ,
      (r : ℂ) * (1 - phase r) = Complex.I * (1 + phase r))
    (hphaseIntegral : E_pvm.integral phase hphaseMeas hphaseBdd =
      cayleyTransform A hA) :
    A ≤ E_pvm.unboundedIntegral ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.eq_of_selfAdjoint_le_formalSelfAdjoint
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.eq_of_selfAdjoint_le_formalSelfAdjoint
    (A B : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A)
    (hAB : A ≤ B) (hB : B.IsFormalAdjoint B) : B = A

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.boundedSesquilinearFormOfQuadratic_apply_self
statement:
theorem Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.boundedSesquilinearFormOfQuadratic_apply_self (x : V) :
    boundedSesquilinearFormOfQuadratic q hq_smul hq_para hq_nonneg hq_le x x = q x

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.StrongContUnitary.mem_generator_domain_iff
statement:
theorem mem_generator_domain_iff (U : StrongContUnitary E) (x : E) :
    x ∈ U.generator.domain ↔
      ∃ y, Filter.Tendsto
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ (Complex.I * (t : ℂ))⁻¹ • (U.toFun t x - x))
        (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds y)

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.StrongContUnitary.tendsto_generator
statement:
theorem tendsto_generator (U : StrongContUnitary E) (x : U.generator.domain) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ (Complex.I * (t : ℂ))⁻¹ • (U.toFun t (x : E) - x))
      (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds (U.generator x))

name: Tengoku.LeanSpectralTheory.StrongContUnitary.generator_isSelfAdjoint
statement:
theorem generator_isSelfAdjoint

statement:
